messages:
mika (design): Quick note from a hallway test: on 360px screens the Console's runs table shows a horizontal scrollbar and the collapsed left nav sits over the action buttons so users can't tap 'Open'. Screenshot: https://imgur.com/example :frowning:

chris (frontend): I can repro at 360x800. .cell-actions has min-width set by a flex child; that forces table width.

devon (mobile): two low-risk fixes: 1) collapse secondary actions into a kebab at <=420px; 2) make the left nav behave as an overlay (position:fixed) so it doesn't push content and block taps. Overlay should be dismissible by swipe or X.

mika (design): prefer overlay + stacked rows under 420px. Stacked rows: primary id on first line, metadata beneath, actions on a separate row. I'll upload 320/375/412 mocks.

anya (product): copy tweak: kebab aria-label should read "More actions for run" and first line in drawer header should be short run id; full model name on second truncated line with long-press to reveal.

aria-a11y-bot: a11y note: overlay must be role="dialog" with aria-modal="true" and a focus trap. Restore focus to the trigger on close. Announce when the overlay opens. Kebab should have an accessible name.

chris (frontend): implementation plan: 1) quick fix: remove min-width on .cell-actions and show kebab at @media (max-width:420px); 2) medium: stacked rows CSS at <=420px using display:grid -> flex-column, keeping the same DOM node so react-window virtualization remains intact. Will put behind ff_mobile_table_layout.

serena (qa): QA checklist: no horizontal scroll at 320/375/412 widths; kebab touch target >=44px; overlay traps focus and restores on close; landscape rotation preserves layout; long-press reveals full name.

mika (design): thanks. I'll update Figma and add acceptance criteria. Can we aim for a patch release next week? Mobile triage is blocking support.

chris (frontend): aiming for a spike PR tomorrow, QA on Friday. Will enable feature flag in canary first.

mika (design): great, adding tasks to the ticket. :thumbsup:
